newsitem.title: FRANCE: French farmer, wanted for murder, kills gendarme.
newsitem.headline: French farmer, wanted for murder, kills gendarme.

text.p: A French farmer sought by police for allegedly killing three people shot dead a gendarme and badly wounded another in southern France on Tuesday before dying himself, police said.

The 64-year-old farmer, Joseph Auvaro, emerged from the woods to fire his shotgun at paramilitary gendarmes guarding the house where he was suspected of having shot dead his son's male companion as well as his own brother-in-law and sister-in-law on Sunday.
Auvaro's body was later found nearby. It was not immediately clear whether he shot himself or had been killed by police.
